v4_additions.notes: Version 4 keeps the version 3 topology and nullable current_as_of date. Health observations and uncontracted candidate research are additive. The authenticated desk must accept 4 without dropping those fields or requiring candidate rows to appear in source_contracts.json. Desk overlay must keep the version 4 maintainer-architecture lede in its known intro set.

repair_observations.notes: The versioned private extension adds structured repair observations without changing the version 4 base envelope. Unaware additive consumers may ignore it; aware consumers inspect the extension marker before reading it. Records are keyed by a stable fingerprint over source, scope and condition only. Only the 'repair' disposition is engineering work; the other dispositions record evaluated source states and are not defects or claims against a publisher. No extension field may enter a public response.

repair_queue.notes: The versioned private extension adds the work grain over repair observations without changing the version 4 base envelope. It keeps one issue per source contract, condition and adapter, with affected-scope count, recency, first evidence, owner, any existing engineering record and any resolution receipt. Only repair-candidate and regressed are engineering work. Nothing but the reviewed register can move an issue past candidate verification or into resolved. An unavailable queue retains null counts rather than rendering zero. No extension field may enter a public response.
